title: Hero — Door Reveal

fields.label: Eyebrow
fields.name: door_eyebrow
fields.instructions: Small uppercase label above the headline.

fields.label: Headline
fields.name: door_headline
fields.instructions: Press Enter for a line break — the break is rendered on the page exactly where you put it. A textarea rather than a plain text field precisely because ACF's text field strips line breaks, and this headline is designed to sit on two lines.
fields.default_value:
We take the
guesswork out of it.

fields.label: Left door bracket render
fields.name: door_bracket_left
fields.instructions: Transparent PNG or WebP of the 3D bracket, sitting near the left door's inner edge. Only the bracket itself — the navy panel and its dot grid are drawn in CSS, so they stay sharp at any viewport size. Leave empty to show the flat vector stand-in instead of a stretched placeholder.

fields.label: Right door bracket render
fields.name: door_bracket_right
fields.instructions: Same as the left, mirrored — sits near the right door's inner edge.

fields.label: Cards
fields.name: door_cards
fields.instructions: The cards revealed behind the doors. 4, 5 or 6 — the grid re-columns itself for each count (4 = two columns, 5-6 = three), so any of them lays out correctly with no template change.

sub_fields.label: Question
sub_fields.name: card_question
sub_fields.instructions: The customer's question, in their words.

sub_fields.label: Answer
sub_fields.name: card_answer
sub_fields.instructions: How ITOI answers it. Hidden visually on phones (≤860px) so the grid still fits one screen — still read out by screen readers there, so nothing is lost.

description: Scroll-driven "door reveal" section (template-parts/home/hero-door-reveal.php, assets/js/door-hero.js), added 2026-09-01 in the homepage slot the Video Showcase used to hold. Two navy doors slide apart as you scroll to reveal the eyebrow/headline/card grid behind them. NOTE: this is the one homepage section whose content lives on the Home page's own edit screen rather than in Site Settings ▸ (homepage) tabs, where every other homepage section keeps its content — that placement was specified explicitly for this section.
